_comment: The one definition of ElasticPro's Zabbix API identity. Read by setup/zbx_api_user.py and by the module's pairing (lib/Pairing.php). Change it here only.
_methods_comment: Read methods for the cluster sync, plus history.push for the core's own request figures (ZABBIX_METRICS_HOST, template ElasticPro request gate by Zabbix trapper). The role is Super admin type, so history.push lets this token write to any trapper item in Zabbix; it still cannot change configuration.
